comparison.objective: Immerse a wafer for a timed interval using pliers while operating a countdown, then return it to three pins; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-held thin-part handling, vertical immersion, timed bimanual button use, and precise replacement versus small fastener/collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: One 28–32 second immersion, correctly timed start/stop, dry hands, no drop, and ≤1 mm/2° return placement; candidate checks mechanical stop response.
comparison.reason: Timed immersion and precision wafer return are different tested abilities; separate control use is only generic overlap.
